glomeris clean — Render what would be cleaned. Executes nothing.

usage: glomeris clean --dry-run [--target <resource_id_or_path>]
                [--project-root <path>]...

Advisory — proposes, never executes.

Builds the real plan for every candidate (or one, with --target) and prints it
without running it. --dry-run is required and there is no flag that removes
it: this command has no executing mode to fall into by typo. To actually act,
use `execute` for one resource or `free` for a target.

Options
  --dry-run
      Required. Omitting it is a usage error, not an execution.
  --target <resource_id_or_path>
      Restrict the output to one resource. Without it, every discovered
      candidate is rendered.
  --project-root <path>
      Same meaning as for `detect`. Repeatable.

Examples
  glomeris clean --dry-run
      What would be removed, exactly?

See also: detect, execute, free
